column20: towards the end of the cave with encrusting sponges and Dendrodoa grossularia forming the main rock cover. Pomatoceros triqueter and spirorbids encrusting the rock
column21: with Ophiopholis aculeata in crevices. A sparse scattering of hydroids included Tubularia indivisa and Kirkenpaureia pinnata. Generally
column22: all very low-lying encrusting sponges.
